Container.Name: craft-stash
Container.Overview: Craft Stash keeps track of your craft supplies (yarn, fabric, beads, paint...), what each project needs, and what to buy. Self-hosted, multi-user, with a JSON API for Home Assistant.[br][br]Photos, uploaded files and backups each get their own folder below, so they can live on the array while the database stays in appdata on the cache. Nothing is written inside the container (the Docker vdisk). Uses SQLite by default; set DATABASE_URL to use PostgreSQL or MariaDB instead. The first account you create is the admin.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. Leave it closed to the internet; put Nginx Proxy Manager or another proxy in front for remote access.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: The database, secret key and temporary files. Keep it on the cache (not a network share).

Config.Name: Photos
Config.Description: Item and step photos, usually the biggest folder. Any share works.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: Uploaded patterns and guides.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Daily database snapshots and safety copies.

Config.Name: PHOTOS_DIR
Config.Description: Where the app keeps photos inside the container (matches the Photos path above). Leave as is.

Config.Name: UPLOADS_DIR
Config.Description: Where the app keeps uploaded files inside the container (matches the Files path above). Leave as is.

Config.Name: BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Where the app keeps backups inside the container (matches the Backups path above). Leave as is.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the files (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the files (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: CHOWN
Config.Description: Fix file ownership at start: auto only where wrong, always everything, never for shares with their own permissions.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the activity log, e.g. Australia/Brisbane.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: 1 behind Nginx Proxy Manager or another reverse proxy.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Only believe proxy headers from these addresses or ranges, e.g. your NPM container's IP or 172.17.0.0/16.

Config.Name: URL_PREFIX
Config.Description: Serve under a path, e.g. /craft for https://example.com/craft/.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: auto = secure cookies whenever the request came in over HTTPS.

Config.Name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
Config.Description: Starting default for open sign-up; the Admin page can change it later.

Config.Name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
Config.Description: Largest single upload.

Config.Name: USER_QUOTA_MB
Config.Description: Uploaded files per user, 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP
Config.Description: Daily database snapshots to keep, 0 = off.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Empty = SQLite in App data. Or an external database: postgresql://user:pass@192.168.1.20:5432/craftstash or mysql://user:pass@192.168.1.20:3306/craftstash

Config.Name: DB_SSLMODE
Config.Description: TLS to an external database: disable, prefer, require or verify-full.

Config.Name: OIDC_ENABLED
Config.Description: 1 = offer 'Log in with single sign-on' (OpenID Connect). See the README.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Your provider's issuer URL, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/craft-stash

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Client ID from the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Client secret from the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_REDIRECT_URI
Config.Description: Optional: https://your-address/login/sso/callback (set it when behind a proxy).

Config.Name: OIDC_AUTO_PROVISION
Config.Description: 1 = create an account at someone's first SSO login.

Config.Name: OIDC_NAME
Config.Description: Button text: Log in with (name), e.g. Authentik.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Generated into App data if empty.
